verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document automatic punctuation, casing, or number formatting in Gladia transcripts, nor any setting to turn formatting off. The closest item is custom spelling (gladia-docs-10), which normalizes spelling variants. That is an adjacent feature, not formatting control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, transcripts come back with punctuation, casing, and number formatting applied, and I can turn the formatting off
